composing_units: 16th Infantry Regiment; 18th Infantry Regiment; 26th Infantry Regiment; attached: 116th Infantry Regiment (29th Division)
notes: Assault division at Omaha (eastern half, Colleville sector). Beachhead only shallow at nightfall.

current_activity: advancing south toward Trévières and Mosles
notes: 18th Infantry drove south toward D-Day objectives north of Trevieres and the Mandeville-Mosles area; 26th Infantry released from reserve 17:45.

current_activity: taking part of Caumont (12 June claim)
notes: Wikipedia Operation Perch footnote: 1st US Infantry Division took part of Caumont on 12 June and the remainder the next day. Competing (earlier) claim.

current_activity: holding Caumont on the V Corps left
notes: Caumont, on the left of the V Corps line, was held by the 1st Division by the end of 13 June (CMH). A Wikipedia footnote has the division taking part of the town on 12 June and the rest on 13 June (conflict G008).
